notes: The document describes Cambridge's Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance (Cambridge Municipal Code Ch. 8.71). It only requires landlords to give tenants an information guide at the start of a tenancy and when termination begins, with a $300-per-day fine for violations. That is a disclosure rule, not one of the six categories. The page says the ordinance 'does not prevent a landlord from initiating an eviction action if otherwise allowed by law,' so it is not a just-cause eviction rule. No rent cap, deposit, fee, screening or algorithmic-pricing rule is stated, so no records were extracted.
